title: Row anchoring and smart hint system for virtual grids
creator: Maya Li
description: Introduce a row anchoring pattern and a contextual smart-hint system for Redwood's virtualized table component. Goal: make very large datasets feel stable during reflow and column resize, reduce user disorientation after sorts/filter changes, and provide inline affordances for density and filter hints without adding visual clutter.
proposal_summary: Add a lightweight row-anchor token that persists a visual anchor (anchor rail + soft-focus) when the viewport's visible rows shift due to reflow. Pair with a contextual hint layer that surfaces non-blocking guidance (filter pills, sorting state descriptions, density toggle) tethered to the anchored row. Hints should be dismissible, animated subtly, and accessible via keyboard and screen readers.
acceptance_criteria: When a sort or live data update reorders rows, the previously focused or selected row stays visually anchored within the viewport (soft animation to new position) instead of abruptly jumping out of view
Column resizes that change row wrapping should preserve the anchor and apply a short fade/slide cue to affected cells
Contextual hint layer shows up to 2 non-blocking hints after relevant actions (sort applied, filters reduced to 0 results, density change) and can be dismissed or re-triggered via keyboard shortcut
All interactions meet WCAG 2.1 AA for color contrast and keyboard operability; screen reader announces anchor and hint state changes concisely
Engineering telemetry points exist for anchor activations, hint impressions, dismissals, and reflow events (PR references included)
Design tokens for anchor color, shadow, and motion timing exist and are documented in the design system tokens page
engineering_notes: Prefer CSS compositing-friendly animations (translate + opacity) to avoid layout thrash during anchor transition
Anchor state should be an overlay layer so we avoid re-rendering large cell trees; use a stable row id mapping from the runtime
Work with runtime team to expose a minimal reflow event API: {visibleRangeStart, visibleRangeEnd, affectedRowIds} - placeholder discussed in infra sync
Fallback behavior for non-virtualized tables: apply the same hint system but without anchor overlay
Edge case: server-sent incremental updates that shift a selected row out of viewport should queue a micro-anchor animation rather than immediate jump
tradeoffs_and_decisions: Decision: implement anchor as visual overlay rather than manipulating DOM order to avoid expensive layout ops - chosen for performance on large grids
Trade-off: overlay provides best perf but complicates focus management; resolved by providing an ARIA live region announcing the new visual location
Decision: limit hint frequency to avoid banner fatigue (max 2 impressions per session, per table) - ties into telemetry
Trade-off: hint rate-limiting may hide actionable guidance for infrequent users; mitigated by adding a 'Show tips' affordance in table toolbar
progress_updates: 2026-02-15: Ticket created after design spike and two usability sessions with power users. Collected example frustrations: 'losing my row' on sort, unclear filter outcomes, surprise wrapping after column resize.
2026-02-22: Low-fidelity prototypes in Figma demonstrating anchor fade and hint pill variations. Chose soft-rail + amber-tint anchor based on contrast tests.
2026-02-28: Engineering sync: agreed on overlay implementation and minimal reflow API. Created ENG-83521 as dependent engineering ticket for runtime reflow hook.
2026-03-04: Accessibility review with SQA: screen reader copy adjusted to 'Row anchored: previously selected item' and hint text shortened for brevity.
2026-03-08: Built HTML/CSS micro-prototype for perf testing. Initial results: anchor overlay adds <3ms per reflow on large table (10k rows) in Chromium with GPU compositing.
2026-03-10: PR opened for design tokens and initial anchor styles (github.com/redwood-inference/ui/pull/4123). Requesting design review and engineering sign-off.
review_comments: Benji Carter (Engineering): 'Overlay approach looks good, but we need a reliable mapping between rowId and DOM index for stream updates. I'll add a utility in runtime to provide stable ids.'
Sofia Morales (PM): 'Make sure hints are configurable per product - some customers will want to disable automated tips. Add a feature flag.'
Ethan Chen (Accessibility): 'Confirm ARIA live region uses polite politeness and concise phrasing; also provide preference to disable animations.'
Design critique (03-09): 'Consider microcopy variations for internationalization; short text reduces truncation in narrow widths.'
ux_risks: Users may find the anchor motion disorienting if timing is too slow; testing across latencies required
Overlay focus handling could confuse screen reader users if not announced correctly
Hints might compete visually with existing toolbar chrome on compact density settings
next_steps: Resolve engineering feedback about stable row id mapping (ENG-83521)
Create a small A/B test in staging to compare anchor vs no-anchor behavior on sort for power users
Finalize token names and add to ds-2026.04 token spec
Ship initial feature behind a runtime feature flag and collect telemetry for 2 weeks
